EZ-B004_calibration_gate.ks_note: the gate uses the KS statistic, not its p-value: a p-value threshold tightens as n grows, which would punish a larger benchmark for being larger
EZ-B004_calibration_gate.on_failure: excluded from scoring with failure class recorded; never silently down-weighted, never published as point metrics without sigma

replay_tolerances.atol_note: gate statistics that sit near zero or are suprema over an order statistic (mean_z, cal_error_90/95, pit_ks_d) are only meaningful on an absolute scale; a pure relative tolerance judges them on the wrong scale. Every EZ-B004 threshold is stated to two decimals, so a 1e-6 floor is four orders of magnitude below anything that can move a verdict.
replay_tolerances.rtol_note: an optimizer-free path (optimizer=None) carries ULP noise only. A fitted path runs L-BFGS-B over the marginal likelihood and converges to a slightly different kernel when the gradient is perturbed at the last place, amplifying the same noise by about three orders of magnitude. Both figures leave roughly an order of magnitude of headroom over measurement.

G0_calibration.requires: every registry model passes EZ-B004 or is excluded with a reason

G1_backbone.requires: at least one physics-rich backbone (published table or historical refit) integrated and scored under the same protocol as the controls, beating the frozen v1 best MAE per epoch or explaining why not

G2_physics_independence.requires: at least two distinct physics-independence groups at tier A_STRICT_BLIND
G2_physics_independence.resolution: WO-205 historical refits; the blind definition is never weakened to compensate
G2_physics_independence.blocks: any model-form uncertainty or frontier physics claim

G3_localization.requires: a shell-capable model class present in EZ-B003-v2 and its rank_1_fraction reported, whatever it is
G3_localization.thresholds: inherited from the frozen v1 criterion; NOT re-tuned

G4_decay_fission_readiness.requires: EZ-B008 passed: blind reproduction of dominant decay mode, Q_alpha and alpha half-life order of magnitude for Z=104-118 with calibrated uncertainty

WO-204: mixed leaderboard is a hard error
